commands.name: reti
commands.usage: reti list [count] | validator <id> | pools <id> | deposit <amt> algo into <validator> for <addr> | withdraw <amt|all> algo from app <pool_app_id> for <addr> | withdraw <amt|all> algo from validator <validator_id> pool <pool_id> for <addr> | balance <addr> | claim <addr>
examples: reti deposit 1000 algo into 123 for alice
reti withdraw 500 algo from app 456 for alice
reti withdraw all algo from app 456 for alice
reti withdraw all algo from validator 1 pool 1 for alice

functions.name: retiList
functions.returns: {validators: [{id: number, owner: string, commissionPct: number, minEntryStakeAlgo: string, maxAlgoPerPoolAlgo: string, epochRoundLength: number, poolsPerNode: number}]}

functions.name: retiValidator
functions.description: Get detailed information for one Reti validator
functions.returns: {validator: {id: number, owner: string, manager: string, commissionPct: number, totalStakedAlgo: string, numPools: number, totalStakers: number, minEntryStakeAlgo: string, gatingType: number, rewardTokenId: number, pools: [{poolId: number, appId: number, totalStakers: number, totalStakedAlgo: string}]}}

functions.name: retiPools
functions.description: Get pools for a specific Reti validator
functions.returns: {pools: [{poolId: number, appId: number, totalStakers: number, totalStakedAlgo: string}]}

functions.name: retiDeposit
functions.description: Deposit ALGO into a Reti validator

functions.name: retiWithdraw
functions.description: Withdraw ALGO from a Reti staking pool

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount of ALGO to unstake or 'all'

functions.name: retiBalance
functions.description: Get Reti staking balances for an account
functions.returns: {stakes: [{validatorId: number, poolId: number, poolAppId: number, balanceAlgo: string, rewardTokenBalance: string, totalRewardedAlgo: string}], totalStakedAlgo: string}

functions.name: retiClaim
functions.description: Claim available Réti reward tokens for an account
functions.returns: {claimedPools: [{poolId: number, poolAppId: number, rewardTokenId?: number, rewardTokenBalance: string}], count: number, rewardTokenOptInRequired: boolean, rewardTokenOptIns: number[]}
